summary: EarthPulse AI is an AI-powered web platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge under the challenge “Dancing with the SARs.” Our project uses NASA-ISRO's NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite data to monitor and identify changes happening on Earth's surface. The platform focuses on flood monitoring, land deformation detection, and environmental change analysis. It aims to process satellite radar information, visualize affected areas through interactive maps, compare changes over time, and generate alerts for potentially dangerous situations. By combining satellite technology, artificial intelligence, and web development, EarthPulse AI aims to provide useful insights for disaster management, environmental monitoring, and early decision-making. Our ultimate goal is to make satellite-based Earth observation easier to understand and more accessible to everyone.
details: •Frontend – Website development HTML – Website structure. CSS – Styling, layout and animations. JavaScript – Interactive features and functionality. •Backend – Processing and logic Python – Main programming language for satellite data processing. Flask or FastAPI – Connects the website with the AI processing system. •Satellite data source NASA–ISRO NISAR mission. NASA Earthdata – Access to satellite data. SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) – Observes Earth's surface in different weather and lighting conditions.
